    The Kirchberg game-separation axiom — operator-algebraic ¬CEP #

    Single external axiom enabling a formally verified, operator-algebraic proof of the failure of the Connes Embedding Problem (¬CEP), with no quantum-complexity language in the derivation.

    Ji, Natarajan, Vidick, Wright, Yuen (MIP*=RE, arXiv:2001.04383, 2020) proved that there exists a finite synchronous nonlocal game G such that G has a commuting-operator (qc) model but NO amenable-trace (qa) model. This qa ≠ qc separation is equivalent to ¬CEP by the Kirchberg equivalences (Kirchberg 1993; Pisier 1996).

    The derivation cep_false_operator_algebraic is sorry-free given one named external input: kirchberg_game_separation (axiom, Ji et al. 2020). The sequence-extraction step tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction (Filter.Germ ultrapower microstate extraction) was discharged from axiom to proved theorem in UltrapowerMicrostateExtraction.lean (commit 556ef4a2f). The backward direction connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace is a proved theorem, and #print axioms cep_false_operator_algebraic reduces to [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, kirchberg_game_separation].

    axiom ZFib.CEP.kirchberg_game_separation :
    ∃ (X : Type) (Ans : Type) (hX : Fintype X) (hAns : Fintype Ans) (hDec : DecidableEq Ans) (G : SyncGame X Ans), Nonempty (GameModel G) ∧ ¬∃ (M : GameModel G), IsAmenableTrace M.τ

    The Kirchberg–Tsirelson game-separation axiom.

    There exists a finite synchronous nonlocal game G (with question set X and answer set Ans) such that G has a commuting-operator model M but NO amenable-trace model.

    The instances Fintype X, Fintype Ans, DecidableEq Ans are passed explicitly via @SyncGame and @GameModel to avoid typeclass-synthesis ambiguity inside an existential quantifier.

    Proved by Ji, Natarajan, Vidick, Wright, Yuen (2020), arXiv:2001.04383. Equivalent C*-algebraic form: C*(F∞) ⊗_max C*(F∞) ≠ C*(F∞) ⊗_min C*(F∞).

    theorem ZFib.CEP.connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (h : ConnesEmbeddable τ) :
    IsAmenableTrace τ

    Connes-embeddability implies matrix-microstate approximability.

    If a tracial C*-algebra embeds trace-preservingly into a tracial matrix ultrapower R^ω, its trace admits finite-dimensional matrix microstates for every (F, ε).

    Mathematical status: classical (Connes 1975; Kirchberg 1993). Lean status: PROVED THEOREM (both this theorem and tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction are proved; no remaining axiom in this chain).

    The proof lives in UltrapowerMicrostateExtraction.lean: connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace_from_seqExtraction uses:

    1. tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction (proved theorem, not an axiom) to get a fixed-n sequence-level embedding with exact pointwise star/multiplication and filter-convergent trace.
    2. ultrafilter_concentration_finite (proved) to find a good index k.
    3. The microstate at k with EXACT star/mul (from pointwise exactness) and approximate trace (from concentration at k), closing IsAmenableTrace τ.

    tracialUltrapower_seqExtraction was the remaining external input (Filter.Germ C*-algebra index-n extraction) and is now a proved theorem (discharged, commit 556ef4a2f; see the git history for the discharge record). No axiom remains in this file beyond kirchberg_game_separation above.

    Citation: Connes, A. (1975). Ann. Math. 104(1); Kirchberg, E. (1993). J. Funct. Anal. 112.

    theorem ZFib.CEP.cep_false_operator_algebraic :
    ConnesNonEmbeddableWitness

    Operator-algebraic proof of ¬CEP.

    Chain (sorry-free given the two named external inputs):

    1. kirchberg_game_separation gives a game G with a qc model M but no qa model.
    2. Therefore ¬ IsAmenableTrace M.τ.
    3. not_amenableTrace_implies_not_connesEmbeddable gives ¬ ConnesEmbeddable M.τ.
    4. ZFib.CEP.ConnesNonEmbeddableWitness is exhibited via M.B and M.τ.

    No quantum-complexity language appears in this proof. The complexity-theoretic content is isolated in kirchberg_game_separation (axiom); the ultrapower extraction step is proved (connesEmbeddable_implies_amenableTrace).

    This is the operator-algebraic core: MIP*=RE enters exactly once, as the cited axiom, and the remainder is standard operator-algebraic reasoning verified by the kernel.
